model_visible_input.description: Steady-state enzyme saturation kinetics relating reaction velocity v to substrate concentration [S].

structural_dissimilarity_reasons: Dimensional divergence: Logistic growth is a 1st-order differential equation in time (dN/dt, units T^-1); Michaelis-Menten is an algebraic quasi-steady-state relation between concentration and reaction velocity.
Nonlinear time evolution vs. instantaneous hyperbolic binding isotherm.
Logistic system has two fixed points (N=0 unstable, N=K stable attractor); Michaelis-Menten has no state-space phase portrait or temporal trajectories.
